name: model_op_sparse_attn_sharedkv
description: SparseAttnSharedKV: DSV4 shared-KV attention over TND queries and a paged shared KV cache (FlagGems-vllm PR #802, sparse_attn_sharedkv). q is [T, 64, 512] bfloat16 in TND layout; ori_kv and cmp_kv are PA_ND paged caches [pages, 128, 1, 512] whose entries serve as both key and value; ori_block_table and cmp_block_table [batch, pages] int32 map logical pages to physical; cu_seqlens_q [batch+1] int32 and seqused_kv [batch] int32 carry the query and KV lengths; sinks [64] float32 add a per-head constant logit that contributes denominator mass but no value. Three modes are selected by the optional inputs: SWA with cmp_kv absent attends only the sliding window of the last ori_win_left+1 original tokens up to each query position; CFA adds the contiguous compressed prefix of (position+1)//cmp_ratio tokens; SCFA instead adds the per-query compressed tokens listed in cmp_sparse_indices [T, 1, topk] int32, where entries that are negative or at or beyond the visible compressed threshold are dropped. Query position is (kv_len - q_len) + t. One softmax spans the sink, the window and the compressed contribution. Returns (attention [T, 64, 512] matching q dtype, empty float32 lse). Requires layout_q TND, layout_kv PA_ND, ori_mask_mode 4, cmp_mask_mode 3, ori_win_left 127 and ori_win_right 0; return_softmax_lse is not supported.
